input.quote: If the Management Committee nevertheless reclaims any capacity in the APCN 2 assigned to such defaulting Party, the defaulting Party shall not be entitled to any payment or credit for the reclaimed capacity.
input.rationale: Subparagraph 23.2 operates as a penalty against us: on a payment default that persists (23.1), our entire APCN 2 capacity can be reclaimed with no payment or credit, and we forfeit all amounts previously paid, while unpaid accounts remain due. That forfeiture is untethered from the size of the default and can far exceed the amount in arrears or the remaining contract value, which is walk-away territory under this rule. We therefore fail the fallback and target the preferred position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by us) with two surgical edits to 23.2: reclamation must be compensated by payment or credit, and no liquidated damages or penalty is payable on default. Retained mechanics stay coherent - unpaid accounts incurred before reclamation remain payable. We do not flag the extended payment charges in Subparagraph 7.9 (default interest on amounts actually owed) or the capital-cost credit rule at p0233 (no refund of sunk capital contributions on voluntary exit after the 25-year Initial Period); these are noted but are not liquidated damages payable by us. A three-month fee cap from the fallback does not fit this ownership consortium, which has capital and O&M cost shares rather than periodic fees.

mappings.element: Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties.

proposal.summary: Convert the default/reclamation forfeiture in Subparagraph 23.2 into a compensated reclamation with no liquidated damages or penalty payable by us.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that we pay no liquidated damages or penalties, so we removed the forfeiture of payment or credit for reclaimed capacity and of amounts already paid, and confirmed that no liquidated damages or penalty is payable on a default. Actual unpaid accounts remain payable under the retained wording.

ops.newText: the defaulting Party shall be entitled to payment or credit for the reclaimed capacity

ops.newText: The defaulting Party shall not be required to pay any liquidated damages or penalty in respect of such default.
